# @vllnt/convex-buckets

> Convex component that stores short-lived groups of opaque subject refs, such as matches, lobbies, rooms and cohorts, with capacity limits and an open, locked, closed lifecycle.

Install `@vllnt/convex-buckets` (unreleased builds from `main` use the `canary`
dist-tag). Peer dependency `convex@^1.45.0`; Node.js `>=20.19.0`. Mount it with
`app.use(config)` from `@vllnt/convex-buckets/convex.config` and call it through
`new Buckets(components.buckets)` from host mutations and queries. Methods:
`open`, `join`, `leave`, `lock`, `close`, `get`, `listMembers`,
`paginateMembers`, `eraseBucket`, `eraseSubject`. Lifecycle: `open` -> `locked`
(no new joins) -> `closed` (terminal). Capacity is enforced on the bucket row's
`memberCount`, so concurrent joins conflict and Convex retries them. `join`
returns `{ joined: false, reason }` (`missing`, `locked`, `closed`,
`already_member`, `full`) instead of throwing. Invalid input throws `ConvexError`
with `data.code` `INVALID_REF`, `INVALID_CAPACITY`, `INVALID_BATCH`,
`INVALID_LIMIT` or `BUCKET_EXISTS`. Refs are 1..256 characters. `listMembers` is
a preview (default 100, clamped to 500); `paginateMembers` reads every member.
Erase batches default to 200 and clamp to 500. The host owns auth and the
meaning of the group; there is no expiry timer, presence heartbeat or React
entry.

## When to use

- Use it when a group lasts for one match, lobby, room or cohort.
- Use it when concurrent joins must never exceed a capacity.
- Use it when you need to stop joins, end the group, then erase it in batches.
- Do not use it when the group outlives a session (orgs, teams, roles): use
  `@vllnt/convex-memberships`.
- Do not use it when you need to know who is online: use `@convex-dev/presence`.

## For coding agents

The docs are bundled in the package at `node_modules/@vllnt/convex-buckets/docs/`
and match the installed version. Read them, and the shipped `src/`, before
writing code. The links below to `./` paths are files inside the installed package.
